assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for original cozy top-down 16-bit laboratory action game, authentic Stardew Valley-inspired chunky pixel craftsmanship, not copied game assets. Square PNG with TRUE transparent alpha. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows, each equal square cell isolated, centered, 20% transparent gutter, no lines, no lettering. Row 1 four walk/bounce frames of a squat glass Erlenmeyer flask monster with amber liquid, teal angry eyes and dark little feet. Row 2 four frames of a red-and-ivory thermometer centipede monster: idle, crouch, dash extended, recover. Row 3 four walk frames of a little gang of three connected blue test tubes with eyes and feet. Row 4 four frames of a purple glass eyedropper monster floating upright: idle, aiming, releasing, recover. All face down-right, same size and anchor across row. Readable original silhouettes using about 24x32 logical pixels enlarged nearest-neighbor. Hard stepped edges, one dark-brown pixel outline, discrete two-tone shading, restricted 20-color desaturated teal, cream, amber, purple palette. NO smoothing, gradients, bloom, gloss, rendered 3D, painted noise, background, ground plane or drawn checkerboard. Every whole sprite inside its cell. Game animation asset, not concept illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for original cozy top-down 16-bit laboratory action game with Stardew Valley-inspired hand-placed chunky pixels, original designs. Square transparent PNG EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows equal square cells. One sprite per cell centered with 20% transparent margins, no text or grid. Row 1 four animation frames of a small walking leafy sprout creature with ochre terracotta root body, two green leaves and simple dark eyes: walk, root down, aim, spit. Row 2 four bounce frames of a squat translucent lavender petri-dish slime monster with cream glass rim, soft wavy jelly shape rendered in hard pixels, tiny eyes. Row 3 four running frames of a small grey mouse MODEL projection with visibly toy-like teal seams, rounded ears, pink tail, not realistic animal. Row 4 four frames of an amber and teal moth specimen creature: wings closed, opening, fully spread, landing. Constant anchors, simple readable 24x32 logical pixel silhouettes enlarged nearest-neighbor, warm brown outline, restricted desaturated green cream lavender amber palette, two-tone discrete shade. No antialiasing, gradients, bloom, painterly texture, realism or 3D. True alpha transparency, no drawn checkerboard or floor. Every sprite complete inside cell. Usable game animation atlas.
